title: Owner action confirmation modal hotfix
scope: Frontend-only repair of the Phase 7.13 Unified Owner Console action preparation/confirmation UI. No new business capability. No Phase 7.14. No weakening of accepted boundaries.
proof_commit: self: the docs commit that adds this file (hash reported in the session final response and git log)

root_cause.reported_symptom: Overview action opens a modal titled 'Confirm action' with a blank body; only Cancel / Confirm & run.
reproduction_method: from-scratch dependency-free Node DOM harness loading the real app.js
real headless Microsoft Edge via Chrome DevTools Protocol against the real local server
root_cause.finding: On the accepted baseline, a successful prepare DOES populate the modal (title + full body, no console errors) in BOTH the DOM harness and real Edge; a literally-blank body for a successful prepare is not a state the baseline produces.
true_cause: No rendering test coverage: the modal was populated by mutating static index.html nodes in openModal(); every existing 7.13 test only string-scans app.js, so a partial/stale/regressed render (the reported static 'Confirm action' + empty body) passes CI undetected.
startAction() handled only HTTP 200; a failed/BLOCKED/SESSION_REQUIRED/CSRF_BLOCKED prepare was dropped to a transient toast and never rendered as a readiness/reason panel.
Confirm & run was never gated on the confirmation phrase (execute.disabled stayed false); exact-match enforced only server-side.
No focus trap, no execution lock (double-click / token reuse), no deterministic Escape/backdrop policy, and export actions never surfaced produced files.

backend_change.note: Byte-identical to baseline; 0 server files in the fix commit. prepare/execute responses already carry every field the modal renders.

required_modal_content_after_success: exact required confirmation phrase (when confirmation required)

modal_dom_harness.runtime: node (dependency-free minimal DOM; fetch shimmed with real backend envelopes; no Internet)

real_browser_verification.baseline_1145a18: modal renders (title changes, body filled) — literal blank NOT reproduced; confirmation action left Confirm ENABLED (execute.disabled=false) — the confirmed gating defect

fixed_7f10274.console_action_export_snapshot: owner title 'Export snapshot', canonical 'export-overview', readiness pill, 7 detail rows, Confirm enabled
fixed_7f10274.confirmation_action_run_watchlist: phrase-required row shows exact phrase; Confirm initially disabled=true; exact phrase -> disabled=false; trailing space -> disabled=true

fresh_worktree_comparison.method: git worktree at baseline vs feature commit; unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py (full run) plus TestLoader.countTestCases() to confirm the exact count delta
fresh_worktree_comparison.baseline_result: 4162 test cases (loader count); baseline worktree full run completed exit 0 with 0 FAIL/ERROR; every one of the 4162 baseline tests also passes inside the feature full run (which reported OK for all 4165), so baseline = 4162 tests, 4 skipped, 0 failures, 0 errors
fresh_worktree_comparison.delta: +3 tests (the new modal tests, all passing); 0 new failure, 0 new error, 0 new skip
fresh_worktree_comparison.wording: The pre-existing suite is byte-identical between the two trees (only test_phase7_13_...py, the new harness, and .gitattributes differ), so every non-7.13 result is baseline-equivalent-nonzero and unchanged. countTestCases: baseline=4162, feature=4165 (delta +3).

known_limitations: Literal blank body for a successful prepare was NOT reproduced on the accepted baseline (both DOM harness and real Edge render it); the fix hardens/completes the contract (the confirmed defects DID reproduce) and adds the previously-absent rendering tests.
The exact === phrase gate is intentionally stricter than the server strip(); it never enables a server-rejected phrase.
Focus-return is exact for Cancel/Escape/blocked paths; after a successful execute the view re-renders behind the modal and focus falls back to body.
The DOM harness is a faithful minimal shim complemented by manual real-browser QA; committed DOM tests skip only if node is unavailable.
